name: dart-flutter-patterns
description: 本番環境対応のDartおよびFlutterパターンは、null安全性、不変状態、非同期構成、ウィジェットアーキテクチャ、人気のある状態管理フレームワーク（BLoC、Riverpod、Provider）、GoRouterナビゲーション、Dioネットワーキング、Freezedコード生成、クリーンアーキテクチャをカバー。
description_zh: 生产就绪的 Dart 和 Flutter 模式涵盖空安全、不可变状态、异步配置、小部件架构、流行的状态管理框架（BLoC、Riverpod、Provider）、GoRouter 导航、Dio 网络、冻结代码生成和干净的架构。

name: frontend-design
description: Guidance for distinctive, intentional visual design when building new UI or reshaping an existing one. Helps with aesthetic direction, typography, and making choices that don't read as templated defaults.
description_zh: 在构建新 UI 或重塑现有 UI 时提供独特、有意的视觉设计指南。有助于美学方向、排版以及做出不被视为模板默认值的选择。

name: skills
description: You MUST use this before any creative work - creating features, building components, adding functionality, modifying behavior, or planning anything new, in software or out of it (a talk, a business, a renovation).
description_zh: You MUST use this before any creative work - creating features, building components, adding functionality, modifying behavior, or planning anything new, in software or out of it (a talk, a business, a renovation).

name: better-ui
description: Polishes surfaces, icons and motion with exact values for border radius, optical alignment, shadows, icon states and animation.
description_zh: Polishes surfaces, icons and motion with exact values for border radius, optical alignment, shadows, icon states and animation.

name: ui-ux-pro-max
description: UI/UX design intelligence for web, mobile, and desktop. This skill should be used when designing, building, reviewing, or fixing interfaces, including pages, components, design systems, accessibility, interaction, responsive layout, typography, color, charts, and stack-specific UI implementation. Searchable local data: 80 searchable styles (51 active), 192 product palettes and reasoning profiles, 74 font pairings, 120 UX guidelines, 105 icons, 17 GSAP presets, 25 chart types, and 22 stacks.
description_zh: UI/UX design intelligence for web, mobile, and desktop. name: interface-design
description: Craft-first interface design for dashboards, admin panels, SaaS apps, tools, settings pages, data interfaces, and interactive products. Use when designing, building, reviewing, auditing, or refining product UI where visual craft, layout hierarchy, tokens, states, visual direction, or design-system consistency matter. Not for marketing pages, landing pages, campaigns, or brand-only work.
description_zh: 针对仪表板、管理面板、SaaS 应用程序、工具、设置页面、数据接口和交互式产品的工艺优先的界面设计。在设计、构建、审查、审核或完善产品 UI 时使用，其中视觉工艺、布局层次结构、标记、状态、视觉方向或设计系统一致性很重要。不适用于营销页面、登陆页面、活动或纯品牌工作。

name: apple-design
description: Apple's approach to interface design and fluid, physical motion, translated for the web. Use when building or reviewing gesture-driven UI, spring animations, drag/swipe/sheet interactions, momentum and interruptible transitions, translucent materials and depth, typography (optical sizing, tracking, leading), reduced-motion, or the design foundations (feedback, spatial consistency, restraint) behind Apple-style interfaces.
description_zh: Apple 的界面设计和流畅的物理运动方法已转化为网络。在构建或审查手势驱动的 UI、弹簧动画、拖动/滑动/纸张交互、动量和可中断过渡、半透明材质和深度、排版（光学尺寸、跟踪、引导）、简化运动或 Apple 风格界面背后的设计基础（反馈、空间一致性、约束）时使用。

name: hallmark
description: Design skill for websites and new pages that look designed, not generated. Use when the user asks to build or design something new, or names Hallmark. Never use it on an existing design unless the user names Hallmark, as in `/hallmark redesign <path>`.
description_zh: Design skill for websites and new pages that look designed, not generated. Use when the user asks to build or design something new, or names Hallmark. Never use it on an existing design unless the user names Hallmark, as in `/hallmark redesign <path>`.

name: taste-skill
description: tasteskill 2.5.1, the anti-slop frontend skill. Builds professional company websites at the level of figma.com and x.ai: plain copy in a voice of its own, one system, one section per screen, equal edges, real photographs and real product UI (licensed stand-in photographs when the client has none; a product render only when the brief asks for 3D), a hero entrance and one or two dealt moments on every page, shader effects and scenes only on tech, gaming and software pages, quiet micro-interactions, and a checker and finish gate that enforce it in a real browser. Use this whenever you build, design, redesign, restyle, polish or review a landing page, company, product, shop, cafe, hotel, studio, SaaS, AI, developer-tool or game site, as static HTML/CSS or inside an existing React, Next.js, Vue, Svelte, Astro or Tailwind project, or when the user says a page looks generic, templated or "AI-made".
